items_flat.title_en: Anthropic files S-1 for proposed Nasdaq IPO under ticker ANT
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 提交 S-1，擬以 ANT 代號在 Nasdaq 上市
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic filed a Form S-1 with the SEC on October 26 for a proposed IPO of Class A common stock on Nasdaq under the symbol ANT. The filing discloses first-half 2026 revenue of about $16.3 billion (up sharply year-over-year) alongside a large net loss driven mainly by fair-value changes on convertible instruments, plus extensive risk factors including catastrophic AI scenarios and large compute commitments.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 於 10 月 26 日向 SEC 提交 Form S-1，計劃以 ANT 代號在 Nasdaq 上市 Class A 普通股。文件披露 2026 上半年營收約 163 億美元（年增顯著），同時出現主要因可轉債公允價值變動導致的巨額淨虧損，並詳列包括災難性 AI 風險與龐大算力承諾在內的風險因素。
items_flat.analysis_en: The filing gives the first detailed public look at Anthropic’s economics and risk factors, testing investor appetite for a pure-play frontier lab amid high compute commitments and safety disclosures. Market pricing and exact offering size remain to be set in later amendments.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此文件首次詳細公開 Anthropic 的財務與風險，檢驗投資人對純前沿實驗室的興趣，同時面對高額算力承諾與安全揭露。最終估值與發行規模仍待後續修訂文件確定。
items_flat.quote: Today, Anthropic, PBC filed a registration statement on Form S-1 with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission relating to its proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今日，Anthropic, PBC 向美國證券交易委員會提交 Form S-1 註冊聲明，涉及其擬議的 Class A 普通股首次公開發行。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI expands Oracle partnership to bring apps into ChatGPT
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 擴展與 Oracle 合作，將應用帶入 ChatGPT
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced an expanded partnership with Oracle on October 27 to integrate Oracle applications and data into ChatGPT and power new Oracle offerings with OpenAI models. New products include Oracle AI Workspace for unified workflows and other AI-powered tools announced at Oracle AI World.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 於 10 月 27 日宣布擴大與 Oracle 的合作，將 Oracle 應用與資料整合進 ChatGPT，並以 OpenAI 模型驅動新的 Oracle 產品。新產品包括用於統一工作流程的 Oracle AI Workspace 等。
items_flat.analysis_en: This deepens enterprise embedding of frontier models into existing ERP and cloud systems, lowering adoption friction for large organizations already on Oracle. Success depends on real workflow integration quality and data governance outcomes.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉深化前沿模型嵌入既有 ERP 與雲端系統，降低大型組織採用摩擦。成敗取決於實際工作流程整合品質與資料治理效果。
items_flat.quote: OpenAI and Oracle are bringing Oracle applications and data into ChatGPT and powering new Oracle products and services with OpenAI models and products.
items_flat.quote_zh: OpenAI與Oracle將Oracle應用程式與資料帶入ChatGPT，並以OpenAI模型與產品驅動新的Oracle產品與服務。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI introduces GPT-6.1 Terra for fast, efficient computer use
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 GPT-6.1 Terra，強化快速高效電腦操作
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Terra on October 26, a fast model emphasizing visual reasoning, computer use, and writing at lower cost. It is available in ChatGPT Work, Codex, and the API (gpt-6.1-terra) at $1/$5 per million input/output tokens.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 於 10 月 26 日發布 GPT-6.1 Terra，強調視覺推理、電腦操作與寫作的快速模型，成本更低。已在 ChatGPT Work、Codex 與 API（gpt-6.1-terra）提供，定價為每百萬輸入/輸出 token 1/5 美元。
items_flat.analysis_en: By cutting price roughly in half while improving speed and factuality on routine professional tasks, Terra aims to make high-volume computer-use agents practical. Independent evaluations of real-world reliability remain limited so far.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 透過約半價與提升速度與事實準確度，Terra 旨在讓高量電腦操作代理更具實用性。目前獨立的真實世界可靠性評估仍有限。
items_flat.quote: We’re introducing GPT-6.1 Terra, a fast, efficient model that combines detailed visual reasoning and precise computer use alongside clearer, more natural writing.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們推出GPT-6.1 Terra，這是一款結合詳細視覺推理與精確電腦操作、並具備更清晰自然寫作的快速高效模型。

items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind announces Genie 4 real-time world model with native audio
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind 宣布 Genie 4 即時世界模型，支援原生音訊
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind announced Genie 4 on October 27, its new real-time interactive world model that generates photorealistic scenes with native audio (ambient sound, music, and adaptive dialogue) and allows natural-language steering. It is rolling out as a research preview to trusted testers, with Google AI Ultra and Gemini API early access planned soon; it builds on Gemini Omni and reasoning models for coherence.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 於 10 月 27 日宣布 Genie 4，其新一代即時互動世界模型可生成帶原生音訊（環境聲、音樂與自適應對話）的寫實場景，並支援自然語言即時操控。目前以研究預覽形式向信任測試者推出，即將進入 Google AI Ultra 與 Gemini API 早期存取；模型基於 Gemini Omni 與推理模型以維持一致性。
items_flat.analysis_en: Native audio and tighter Gemini-in-the-loop control mark a practical step toward usable interactive simulation for robotics training, creative tools, and agent testing. Broad availability, cost, and long-horizon consistency remain open questions.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 原生音訊與更緊密的 Gemini 迴路控制，是邁向可用互動模擬（機器人訓練、創作工具、代理測試）的實務一步。廣泛可用性、成本與長時一致性仍待觀察。
items_flat.quote: Today, we are announcing Genie 4, our new world model, which unlocks unprecedented realism and improves real-time interactive simulation. Genie 4 is natively multimodal, enabling audio... to be simultaneously generated with the world.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今日，我們宣布 Genie 4，我們的新世界模型，解鎖前所未有的真實感並改善即時互動模擬。Genie 4 原生多模態，使音訊能與世界同時生成。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI announces three AI-generated scientific results with academic shepherding
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 宣布三項 AI 生成科學成果，並由學術社群協助理解
items_flat.summary_en: On October 26 OpenAI announced three discoveries produced by its models in mathematics (local smoothing conjecture), computer science (a claimed disproof of the Exponential Time Hypothesis for 3-SAT with Lean formalization), and physics (existence proof related to QCD-type theories). The company is partnering with external academic experts to shepherd verification and explanation rather than claiming academic credit itself.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 於 10 月 26 日宣布其模型產生的三項發現：數學（局部平滑猜想）、電腦科學（聲稱以 Lean 形式化推翻 3-SAT 的指數時間假設）與物理（QCD 類型理論相關存在性證明）。公司正與外部學術專家合作協助驗證與解釋，本身不主張學術貢獻。
items_flat.analysis_en: If independently verified, these would be among the strongest public signals of frontier models contributing novel theoretical results. Expert review is still underway, and prior similar claims have required corrections.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 若經獨立驗證，這些將是前沿模型貢獻新理論結果的最強公開訊號之一。專家審查仍在進行，先前類似宣稱也曾需要修正。
items_flat.quote: We are announcing three new discoveries in mathematics, computer science, and physics about harmonic analysis, complexity theory, and quantum field theory.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們宣布數學、電腦科學與物理領域的三項新發現，涉及調和分析、複雜性理論與量子場論。

items_flat.title_en: Meta plans up to $95 billion equity raise to fund AI infrastructure
items_flat.title_zh: Meta 計劃最多籌集 950 億美元股權，資助 AI 基礎設施
items_flat.summary_en: On October 26 Meta announced plans to raise up to $95 billion through equity offerings to fund AI infrastructure and superintelligence investments. This includes roughly $35 billion in concurrent public offerings of Class A stock and convertible preferred securities, plus a planned up-to-$60 billion at-the-market program in new non-voting Class C shares expected after early 2027; Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom indicated interest in up to $5 billion of the Class A portion.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta 於 10 月 26 日宣布計劃透過股權發行最多籌集 950 億美元，資助 AI 基礎設施與超智慧投資。包括約 350 億美元的 Class A 股票與可轉換優先證券公開發行，以及計劃中的最高 600 億美元新非投票 Class C 股票市價發行計畫（預計 2027 年初後）；Nvidia、AMD 與 Broadcom 表達對 Class A 部分最高 50 億美元的興趣。
items_flat.analysis_en: The scale underscores how even cash-rich hyperscalers are turning to equity markets to finance the next wave of compute build-out. Timing of the larger Class C tranche and overall dilution remain subject to market conditions.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此規模顯示即使現金充裕的超大規模業者也轉向股權市場為下一波算力建設融資。較大 Class C 部分的時點與整體稀釋程度仍取決於市場狀況。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic shares early results using Claude to accelerate drug development
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 分享使用 Claude 加速藥物開發的早期成果
items_flat.summary_en: On October 27 Anthropic published early results from life-sciences partnerships with six organizations (including Generate Biomedicines, Divergence Labs, Enveda, Bristol Myers Squibb and others) plus internal programs. Examples include Claude generating tens of thousands of antibody designs, cutting manufacturing document review time by ~89%, and assisting CAR-T and regulatory drafting work.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 於 10 月 27 日公布與六家藥物開發組織（包括 Generate Biomedicines、Divergence Labs、Enveda、Bristol Myers Squibb 等）合作及內部計畫的早期成果。案例包括 Claude 生成數萬個抗體設計、將製造文件審查時間縮減約 89%，以及協助 CAR-T 與法規文件草擬。
items_flat.analysis_en: These are early, mostly preclinical demonstrations that Claude can compress specific bottlenecks across design, documentation and operations. Whether the gains translate into approved therapies or generalizable pipelines still requires independent validation.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這些是早期、多為臨床前的展示，顯示 Claude 能壓縮設計、文件與營運的特定瓶頸。成效能否轉化為獲批療法或可推廣管線，仍需獨立驗證。
items_flat.quote: Over the past several months, our scientists have engaged in deep research partnerships with six organizations developing new medicines. We’ve also begun drug discovery efforts of our own.
items_flat.quote_zh: 過去數月，我們的科學家與六家開發新藥的組織進行深度研究合作。我們也開始了自己的藥物發現工作。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic expands GSA OneGov deal with 40% discount on Claude for governments
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 擴大 GSA OneGov 協議，政府使用 Claude 享 40% 折扣
items_flat.summary_en: On October 27 Anthropic and the U.S. General Services Administration announced an expanded OneGov agreement offering a 40% discount on consumption-based pricing for Claude models available to federal, state, local, tribal and territorial governments, with no minimums and FedRAMP-authorized options. Usage among government organizations has grown substantially.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 與美國總務署於 10 月 27 日宣布擴大 OneGov 協議，向聯邦、州、地方、部落與領地政府提供 Claude 模型消費制 40% 折扣，無最低消費，並含 FedRAMP 授權選項。政府組織使用量已大幅成長。
items_flat.analysis_en: The shift to discounted usage pricing lowers the barrier for public-sector adoption beyond prior promotional offers. Actual mission impact will depend on procurement speed, security approvals and sustained utilization.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 轉向折扣用量計價降低了公共部門採用門檻。實際任務影響仍取決於採購速度、安全審批與持續使用量。
items_flat.quote: We are expanding our partnership with the General Services Administration (GSA) through a new agreement that gives government partners a 40% discount on Claude Enterprise, Claude for Government, and the Claude API.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們正擴大與總務署（GSA）的合作，透過新協議為政府夥伴在 Claude Enterprise、Claude for Government 與 Claude API 提供 40% 折扣。

google.summary_en: Google DeepMind announced Genie 4 on October 27, its new real-time interactive world model that generates photorealistic scenes with native audio (ambient sound, music, and adaptive dialogue) and allows natural-language steering. It is rolling out as a research preview to trusted testers, with Google AI Ultra and Gemini API early access planned soon; it builds on Gemini Omni and reasoning models for coherence.
google.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 於 10 月 27 日宣布 Genie 4，其新一代即時互動世界模型可生成帶原生音訊（環境聲、音樂與自適應對話）的寫實場景，並支援自然語言即時操控。目前以研究預覽形式向信任測試者推出，即將進入 Google AI Ultra 與 Gemini API 早期存取；模型基於 Gemini Omni 與推理模型以維持一致性。
google.analysis_en: Native audio and tighter Gemini-in-the-loop control mark a practical step toward usable interactive simulation for robotics training, creative tools, and agent testing. Broad availability, cost, and long-horizon consistency remain open questions.
google.analysis_zh: 原生音訊與更緊密的 Gemini 迴路控制，是邁向可用互動模擬（機器人訓練、創作工具、代理測試）的實務一步。廣泛可用性、成本與長時一致性仍待觀察。
google.quote: Today, we are announcing Genie 4, our new world model, which unlocks unprecedented realism and improves real-time interactive simulation. Genie 4 is natively multimodal, enabling audio... to be simultaneously generated with the world.
google.quote_zh: 今日，我們宣布 Genie 4，我們的新世界模型，解鎖前所未有的真實感並改善即時互動模擬。Genie 4 原生多模態，使音訊能與世界同時生成。

meta.title_en: Meta plans up to $95 billion equity raise to fund AI infrastructure
meta.title_zh: Meta 計劃最多籌集 950 億美元股權，資助 AI 基礎設施
meta.summary_en: On October 26 Meta announced plans to raise up to $95 billion through equity offerings to fund AI infrastructure and superintelligence investments. This includes roughly $35 billion in concurrent public offerings of Class A stock and convertible preferred securities, plus a planned up-to-$60 billion at-the-market program in new non-voting Class C shares expected after early 2027; Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom indicated interest in up to $5 billion of the Class A portion.
meta.summary_zh: Meta 於 10 月 26 日宣布計劃透過股權發行最多籌集 950 億美元，資助 AI 基礎設施與超智慧投資。包括約 350 億美元的 Class A 股票與可轉換優先證券公開發行，以及計劃中的最高 600 億美元新非投票 Class C 股票市價發行計畫（預計 2027 年初後）；Nvidia、AMD 與 Broadcom 表達對 Class A 部分最高 50 億美元的興趣。
meta.analysis_en: The scale underscores how even cash-rich hyperscalers are turning to equity markets to finance the next wave of compute build-out. Timing of the larger Class C tranche and overall dilution remain subject to market conditions.
meta.analysis_zh: 此規模顯示即使現金充裕的超大規模業者也轉向股權市場為下一波算力建設融資。較大 Class C 部分的時點與整體稀釋程度仍取決於市場狀況。

brief_en: Anthropic’s S-1 IPO filing reveals $16.3B H1 revenue and large losses; OpenAI ships cheaper GPT-6.1 Terra and expands Oracle apps; DeepMind launches Genie 4 real-time world model with native audio; labs advance science and government access.
brief_zh: Anthropic 提交 S-1 上市文件，上半年營收 163 億美元；OpenAI 推出低價 GPT-6.1 Terra 並擴展 Oracle 合作；DeepMind 發布帶原生音訊的 Genie 4 世界模型；多家實驗室推進科學與政府應用。
